content: Wi u kĩ u yɛ̃ru wɑ, u rɑ wure bu nùn sɛɛyɑsiɑ. Wi u yinɑmɔ bu nùn wɔkisi, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ.
Wi u rɑ ɡeɑ ko, wiyɑ u rɑ Gusunɔn durom wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ bwisiku kɔ̃sunuɡiiwɑ u rɑ tɑɑrɛ wɑ.
Nuku kɔ̃surɑ kun kpɛ̃ tu tɔnu tɑ̃sisiɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡiin nuuru tɑ ko n sirerewɑ.
Kurɔ ɡeo u rɑ dewɑ win durɔ u n bɛɛrɛ mɔ, ɑdɑmɑ kurɔ wi u rɑ win durɔ sekuru doke, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe bɑrɑru te tɑ durɔ win kukunu temmɔ.
Gemɡibu bɑ rɑ n kɑsuwɑ bu ko dee dee, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ rɑ n kɑsuwɑ bu ɡbɛni.
Tɔn kɔ̃son ɡɑri yi sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe yinɑ ye yɑ rɑ ɡo, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡibun ɡɑri yi rɑ tɔmbu ɡbɑrewɑ yinɑn di.
Tɔn kɔ̃so ù n ɡu, ɡɑ̃ɑnu ku rɑ tiɑre win yɛnuɔ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡiin yɛnu ɡɑ rɑ n yɔ̃wɑ dim dim.
Bwisiɡiiwɑ bɑ rɑ tɔmɛ, ɑdɑmɑ wìn ɡɑri kɔmiɑ wiyɑ bɑ rɑ yɑɑkoru ko.
N burɑm bo ɑ n sɑ̃ɑ bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛ, kpɑ ɑ n sɔm kowo turo mɔ, ye kɑɑ n kɑ tii sue, kpɑ ɑ kun dĩɑnu mɔ yɛnuɔ.
Ye ɡemɡii u mɔ, u rɑ ye nɔɔriwɑ, sere kɑ mɑm win yɑɑ sɑbenɔ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃so, nuku kɔ̃surɑ u rɑ n yibɑ.
Wi u win ɡberu wukɑ u ko n dĩɑnu yibɑwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u kɑm ɡire u sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ.
Tɔn kɔ̃sowɑ u rɑ n tɔn kɔ̃sobun ɡɑ̃ɑnun binɛ mɔ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡibun tɛmɑnɑbu, ɑrufɑɑniwɑ bu rɑ mɑ.
Tɔn kɔ̃so u rɑ yinɑ mwɑɑrewɑ win ɡɑri weesuɡii sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡii u rɑ yɑriwɑ wɑhɑlɑn di.
Tɔnun ɡere yɑ koo nùn ɡɑ̃ɑ ɡeenu mɑruɑ nɡe mɛ win sɔmburu tɑ rɑ nùn ɑre wɛ̃.
Gɑri bɔkɔ u rɑ n tɑmɑɑ ye u mɔ̀ kpuro yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ dee dee, ɑdɑmɑ bwisiɡiiwɑ u rɑ kɑ bwisi kɛ̃ru sɔmburu ko.
Gɑri bɔkɔ u rɑ yɑnde win mɔru sɔ̃ɔsiwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ bwisiɡii u rɑ tii ye mɑrisiwɑ.
Wi u ɡem kpɑrɑmɔ, ɡeɑ u rɑ kɑ̃, ɑdɑmɑ wee kowo u rɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ weesun yoo.
Wi u rɑ ɡɑri ɡere u kun bwisikɑ, u rɑ kɑ yi tɔmbu sɔkuwɑ nɡe tɑkobi, ɑdɑmɑ bwisiɡiin ɡɑri yi rɑ tɔnu bɛkiewɑ.
Gɑri ɡeen dɑm mu rɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ, ɑdɑmɑ weesu su rɑ doonɛwɑ nɔni kpɑki teeru.
Be bɑ rɑ kɔ̃sɑ bwisiku, weesɑ su rɑ n yibɑ ben ɡɔ̃ruɔ, ɑdɑmɑ be bɑ rɑ tɔmbu bwisi kɛ̃ bu kɑ ɡeɑ ko, bɑ rɑ n nuku dobu mɔwɑ.
Kɔ̃sɑ ku rɑ ɡemɡii deemɛ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃so u rɑ n nɔni sɔ̃ɔrewɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u ku rɑ weesuɡibu kɑ̃. Gemɡibɑ u rɑ n kĩ.
Bwisiɡii u ku rɑ win yɛ̃ru tɛrie, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ u rɑ win ɡɑri bɑkɑru sɔ̃ɔsiwɑ.
Hɑniɑ yɑ rɑ dewɑ tɔnu u ko ɡɑbun yinni, kpɑ yikuru tu de tɔnu u ko ɡoon yoo.
Wururɑbu bu rɑ tɔnu woorewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɑ̀ n tɔnu ɡɑri sɔ̃ɔwɑ kɑ kĩru yi rɑ nùn dɑm kɛ̃wɑ.
Gemɡii u rɑ win beruse surewɑ swɑɑ ɡeɑ sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃son kookoosu su rɑ dewɑ u kɔ̃ɔrɑ.
Tɑɑso wi u yikuru mɔ, u ku rɑ yɑɑ wɑ u sɛ̃wɛ, ɑdɑmɑ hɑniɑwɑ yɑ rɑ tɔnu ɡɑ̃ɑ ɡeenu wɛ̃.
Mi ɡem wɑ̃ɑ, miyɑ wɑ̃ɑrɑ wɑ̃ɑ. À n mu swĩi, ɑ ǹ kɑ ɡɔɔ yinnɑmɔ.
